sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Step flashing, generic flashing and overlap need distinct French trade senses. Archived solin à gradins and solin may fit a regional product but the approved wall/roof detail and overlap are unspecified. Resolve senses with the qualified roofer and dictionary reviewer.

Shingle course, sidewall and siding are separate roof/wall components. Archived rang, mur latéral and revêtement mural need context so the next-course inspection does not imply a universal installation detail.

The source gives under-each-course, one-piece-per-course and bending instructions, but manufacturer and approved wall/roof detail are not specified. Sealant use and bend method likewise depend on product. No scored or audio construction command should be selected until qualified detail and safety review.

Source card 10 is a fragment about step flashing under each course; archived French converts it to an imperative. Source speaking asks the installer to describe the sequence, whereas archived speaking adds a request to show approved detail/overlap. Preserve exact source meaning and keep additions as review evidence.
